name: Kylian Mbappe
rootCause: French football star Kylian Mbappe's X account was hacked, and a token called MBAPPE was posted. The tweet has since been deleted. The MBAPPE token's market value skyrocketed to tens of millions of dollars within minutes, only to quickly plummet to zero.
